title: Build log, 2026-10-22
body:
What changed on the site, straight from the commit log:
- docs(checks): background-html library is optional, not required in deploy worktrees (c1f62f5)
- fix(deploy): fail fast when the full check tier runs without .env.local (17c15a0)
- fix(phone): keep malformed suggested replies from blanking the site (#193) (41fc630)
- fix(place): keep the F prompts clear of the Find walk pad at narrow widths (#175, #176) (c96d0a9)
- fix(place): give mouse-only visitors the walk pad while a Find goal is set (#175, #176) (e68de27)
- fix(checks): configure isolated stubs for scene and card journeys (8d4cba6)
- fix(checks): isolate stub models and find actual next desk attendance (7f087b8)
- fix(world): keep visible backgrounds animated behind character and phone overlays (c5f1555)
- and more in the commit log
